configuration.corpus: one scanRepo() result per case, shared by every arm
configuration.recordedCorpusFields: rankings, hit outcomes, and deterministic evidence only; platform-dependent checkout counts and timings are deliberately omitted
configuration.searchField: file path + scanner text sample (files over the scanner's sample limit are truncated for every arm alike)
configuration.tokenizer: lowercase [A-Za-z0-9_$]+ of length >= 3, plus camelCase and underscore sub-tokens
configuration.caseSensitivity: case-insensitive for both keyword arms, which favours the baselines

candidatePolicies.raw: every scanned file; ranks READMEs first and is not a fair comparison
candidatePolicies.code: isSource && !isTest && kind === 'code' — also drops documentation, as FixMap's scoring effectively does for implementation tasks

armDescriptions.path-extraction: path-shaped tokens read out of the task text, resolved against the corpus, ranked by order of appearance
armDescriptions.lexical-literal: literal keyword search ranked by distinct query terms matched, then raw occurrence count
armDescriptions.bm25: BM25 retrieval over the same text; a retrieval baseline, not a grep
armDescriptions.fixmap: rankContextFiles from @aryam/fixmap-core, which applies its own candidate gate internally
